visual_argument: One machined tray stands for one node, so the 64 steel trays of Frontera against the 8 black trays of Vista read as an eight to one count at one scale, without a speed, a bar or an axis.
build_risk: Seventy two identical tray tops in a TXBENCH plan relief, where the units must read as machined trays with lit chamfers and casts into deep gutters rather than as blinds, a keyboard or a flat printed grid at 432 px.
distinct_from_recent: No. 70 was an outdoor floodlit rig floor with a robot arm and dusk_ember bands, no. 71 a Dallas residential street at night with kit people and bluebonnet, no. 72 a dark lab at last light with a brass and bone protein model and brass tiles. This deck is a windowless machine hall under a cold flood with counted tray towers, membrane section reliefs in steel and copper, no person, no vehicle and a cyan accent.
